changelog:
taste-rilke 0.1.0 — Initial Release

- Introduces a literary voice skill inspired by Rainer Maria Rilke, focusing on his signature Dinggedicht technique and themes of solitude, transformation, and attentive observation.
- Includes style tokens, anti-tokens, and signature passages from core works like Duino Elegies and Letters to a Young Poet.
- Outlines application rules for writing, UI design, and branding based on Rilke’s aesthetic principles.
- Provides clear evaluation criteria for output in this literary style.
- Live demo link available for real-time testing with any text.
summary: Emulates Rilke’s literary voice by focusing sustained attention on a single object, revealing depth through detailed, contemplative description.
